dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A probability mass function on natural numbers obtained by mapping a Boolean trial to 1 when it is true and to 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the discrete distribution whose masses at 1, 0, and all other natural numbers are asserted in the first three conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: A probability mass function on real numbers obtained by mapping a Boolean trial to real 1 when true and real 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its associated measure is used for the mean and centered second-moment integrals in the last two conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the additive-monoid-with-one structure from an additive-commutative-monoid-with-one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies part of the typeclass path used to interpret the numeral 1 in ENNReal.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the distinguished-one operation from an additive monoid with one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Allows the ENNReal numeral 1 in the mass expression 1 minus p to elaborate.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Combines the five asserted facts into a nested conjunction.

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe
dependency_coverage.meaning: Coerces a function-like object to its underlying function so it can be evaluated.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Allows each PMF to be evaluated at a natural-number outcome.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The extended nonnegative real numbers, represented as nonnegative reals with a top element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the codomain of PMF masses and the type in which the mass equalities are stated.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtraction operation on extended nonnegative real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the probability mass at 0 as ENNReal 1 minus the embedded parameter p.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal.ofNNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical embedding of a nonnegative real into the extended nonnegative reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Converts p into the type of PMF values for the asserted mass at 1 and the complementary mass at 0.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality between two terms of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses all mass and integral identities in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous multiplication operation selected by a typeclass instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the real product p times 1 minus p in the centered second-moment formula.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous exponentiation operation selected by a typeclass instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the square of x minus p in the centered second-moment integrand.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous subtraction operation selected by a typeclass instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets both ENNReal 1 minus p and real differences x minus p and 1 minus p.

dependency_coverage.name: InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts a normed-space structure from an inner-product-space structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the real normed-space instance needed for the Bochner integrals.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict-order relation supplied by an LT typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses the assumptions that p is strictly greater than 0 and strictly less than 1.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.integral
dependency_coverage.meaning: The measure-theoretic Bochner integral of a function against a measure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the expectation of x and the expectation of the squared centered deviation under LocalDef002.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds natural-number exponentiation from a monoid's repeated multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the exponent 2 denote the ordinary square of a real number.

dependency_coverage.name: NNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of nonnegative real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of the probability parameter p.

dependency_coverage.name: NNReal.toReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the underlying real value of a nonnegative real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Converts p to a real for the mean, centering term, and product in the integral conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the outcome type of LocalDef001 and the type of the arbitrary outcome k.

dependency_coverage.name: Ne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Inequality, defined as the negation of equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: States that an arbitrary natural outcome k is neither 0 nor 1 before concluding its mass is zero.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts a seminormed additive commutative group from a normed additive commutative group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides an inherited analytic structure used to construct the normed-space instance for real-valued integration.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a target type through an OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the literals 0, 1, and 2 occurring throughout the assumptions and conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs interpretation of the numeral 1 from a type's One operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports occurrences of 1 in NNReal, ENNReal, and Real.

dependency_coverage.name: PMF
dependency_coverage.meaning: A probability mass function, represented by an ENNReal-valued function whose values sum to 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the distribution type of both locally defined random variables.

dependency_coverage.name: PMF.instFunLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: The function-like instance that evaluates a PMF at an outcome to obtain its mass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives meaning to the expressions LocalDef001 applied to 0, 1, or k.

dependency_coverage.name: PMF.toMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a PMF on a measurable space into its associated measure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the measure against which the two real-valued integrals are taken.

dependency_coverage.name: PartialOrder.toPreorder
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts a preorder from a partial order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the preorder structure used to interpret strict comparison and to derive a non-strict bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Preorder.toLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the strict-less-than relation from a preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the strict ordering used in 0 less than p and p less than 1.

dependency_coverage.name: RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides a real inner-product-space structure on an RCLike type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specialized to Real, it participates in furnishing the normed-space structure required by the real integrals.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the outcome type of LocalDef002 and the value type of both integrals and their right-hand sides.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides natural-number powers on reals, including the square in the centered second moment.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplication operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets multiplication in p times 1 minus p.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished real number one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets real 1 in the mapped distribution and in the factor 1 minus p.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instRCLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: The RCLike structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the analytic instance chain used to integrate real-valued functions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtraction operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets x minus p in the centered integrand and 1 minus p in its asserted value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.measurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Borel measurable-space structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes LocalDef002's associated real measure and the two integrals well-typed.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normed additive commutative group structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the normed additive target structure required for Bochner integration.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs interpretation of the numeral 0 from a type's Zero operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports occurrences of 0 in NNReal and ENNReal, including the lower bound and zero-mass conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddCommMonoidWithOneENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid with one structure on ENNReal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the ENNReal numeral 1 used in the complementary probability mass.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a homogeneous multiplication operation into the HMul interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects real multiplication to the heterogeneous multiplication notation in the final equality.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a power operation into the HPow interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects real natural-number exponentiation to the notation for squaring x minus p.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a homogeneous subtraction operation into the HSub interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects ENNReal and Real subtraction to the subtraction notation in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of each natural-number literal as itself in Nat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the natural outcomes 0 and 1 and the exponent 2.

dependency_coverage.name: instOneNNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished one in the nonnegative real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the upper endpoint 1 in the assumption p less than 1 and in the bound required by the local definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: instPartialOrderNNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The inherited partial order on nonnegative real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the meanings of 0 less than p, p less than 1, and the derived p less than or equal to 1.

dependency_coverage.name: instZeroENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished zero in the extended nonnegative real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the asserted zero mass outside outcomes 0 and 1.

dependency_coverage.name: instZeroNNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished zero in the nonnegative real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the lower endpoint 0 in the strict positivity assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: le_of_lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a strict inequality into the corresponding non-strict inequality in a preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Derives p less than or equal to 1 from p less than 1 so that LocalDef001 and LocalDef002 can be constructed.

dependency_coverage.name: Bool
dependency_coverage.meaning: The two-valued Boolean type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the source outcome type of the underlying trial mapped by both local definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Bool.true
dependency_coverage.meaning: The true constructor of Bool.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: LocalDef001 maps precisely this Boolean outcome to natural 1, with the other Boolean outcome mapped to 0.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The non-strict-order relation supplied by an LE typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses the p less than or equal to 1 parameter required to construct the underlying Boolean PMF.

dependency_coverage.name: PMF.bernoulli
dependency_coverage.meaning: A Boolean probability mass function assigning mass p to true and mass 1 minus p to false, assuming p is at most 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the underlying two-outcome distribution from which both local PMFs are mapped, determining all stated masses and moments.

dependency_coverage.name: PMF.map
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pushes a probability mass function forward along a function between outcome types.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Transforms the Boolean trial into a 0-or-1-valued PMF on Nat or Real.

dependency_coverage.name: Preorder.toLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the non-strict-order relation from a preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the ordering relation used by the p less than or equal to 1 argument of the local definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished real number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the false branch of the real-valued 0-or-1 mapping in LocalDef002.

dependency_coverage.name: cond
dependency_coverage.meaning: Boolean conditional selection, returning one branch for true and the other for false.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements the Boolean conditional mapping used by LocalDef002 to produce real 1 or 0.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqBool
dependency_coverage.meaning: The decision procedure for equality of Boolean values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the test of whether a Boolean equals true decidable in LocalDef001's conditional mapping.

dependency_coverage.name: ite
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proposition-based if-then-else chosen using a decision procedure for its condition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements LocalDef001's mapping from true to natural 1 and otherwise to natural 0.

binders: p is a nonnegative real number.
hypotheses: p is strictly less than 1: p < 1.
conclusions: The natural-valued 0-or-1 distribution LocalDef001 assigns probability p to the outcome 1.
The same distribution assigns probability 1 - p to the outcome 0.
For every natural number k distinct from both 0 and 1, the same distribution assigns probability 0 to k.
The integral of the identity function against the measure associated with the real-valued 0-or-1 distribution LocalDef002 equals the real value of p.
The integral of (x - p)^2 against that measure equals p(1 - p), with p interpreted as a real number.
mathematical_definitions: LocalDef001 is the pushforward of a Boolean trial with true probability p under the map true to natural 1 and false to natural 0.
LocalDef002 is the pushforward of the same Boolean trial under the map true to real 1 and false to real 0.
Evaluating a PMF at an outcome gives its ENNReal-valued probability mass.
Converting LocalDef002 to a measure permits its expectation and centered second moment to be written as integrals.
The final two identities state that the real-valued 0-or-1 random variable has mean p and variance, equivalently centered second moment, p(1 - p).
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every nonnegative real parameter p strictly between 0 and 1, the associated 0-or-1 trial has probability p at 1, probability 1 - p at 0, and zero probability at every other natural-number outcome; its real-valued version has expectation p and centered second moment p(1 - p).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The parameter is restricted by strict inequalities 0 < p < 1; the endpoint cases p = 0 and p = 1 are not covered even though analogous formulas may remain meaningful there.
The local distributions require only p <= 1, and this requirement is supplied by deriving it from the stronger hypothesis p < 1.
ENNReal subtraction is generally truncated, but because p <= 1 here, the term 1 - ENNReal.ofNNReal p represents the ordinary complementary probability.
The zero-mass statement is conditional on k being distinct from both 0 and 1; it makes no assertion about k when either premise fails.
The hypotheses are jointly satisfiable, so the universally quantified implication is not vacuous merely from an impossible parameter range.
ambiguities: The target uses integrals directly rather than explicitly naming expectation or variance; interpreting them as the mean and centered second moment follows from the displayed identity and squared-deviation integrand.
The natural-valued and real-valued local distributions are separate pushforwards of the same Boolean PMF, although both represent the same 0-or-1 law in different codomains.
No substantive ambiguity remains about which Boolean outcome receives probability p: the dependency definitions assign p to true, and both local mappings send true to 1.
